name: Asaju Haneefah Oluwakorede
bio: Haneefah is a committed medical student with a deep passion for women's health and mental health. She's a natural leader, known for her consistency, responsibility, and dedication to every task she takes on. Haneefah previously worked as the head protocol officer for the international health and leadership summit 2024. She also works as the creative director for The Still Water Foundation Nile university chapter.
